newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares end week fairly active but weaker.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares end week fairly active but weaker.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares were slightly more active on Friday but traded largely weaker, with most investors' money remaining locked in new issues, brokers said.
The key industrial index shed 9.99 points to close at 10,066.58, losing 115.29 points on the week.
"Investors funds are still going to the new issues, thus diverting funds from existing counters where there's very thin trading," commented one broker.
The main losses of the day were in newspaper group Zimpapers which tumbled 100 cents to 4,700 while bankers Barclays also fell by the same margin to 3,300 cents.
In minings, a 500 cent jump to 10,000 in gold giant Ashanti nudged the seven-counter index 2.32 points to 972.21 but it was 18.02 points easier on the week.
